reason: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:43 and app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:105-111, `:website_name` is serialized as an attribute but omitted from `untrusted_attributes` (unlike `:website`), and neither `website_name` nor `include_website_name` (app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:137-155, which also lacks a trailing `?`) checks `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)`. As a result, TL0 users' website host/path is still exposed to anonymous viewers despite `UserGuardian#restrict_user_fields?` (lib/guardian/user_guardian.rb:58-60), and is even rendered on the profile page (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/user/user.hbs:69-76).
